title: UP-1592: Add dataset locator validations and unit tests
summary: Adds schema validation for dataset locators to ensure created, available, and patched datasets conform to required locator constraints. A new datasets operator module enforces these validations across dataset creation and modification endpoints, with comprehensive unit test coverage to verify correct behavior and error handling.
userImpact: Users will now receive clear validation errors if datasets are created or modified with invalid locator configurations, preventing invalid data from entering the system.
author: alex380125

title: UP-1601 - Add correction for 0 indexing shield connector pages
summary: Fixed page indexing mismatch between Shield connector (0-indexed) and Scope's internal standard (1-indexed). The Shield connector now applies a correction to translate pagination values from Scope's 1-indexed format to Shield's 0-indexed format.
userImpact: Page-based pagination with the Shield connector now works correctly without off-by-one errors.
author: peter496

title: UP-1600 - UP-1654 - UP-1430 - Move SQLAlchemy code to 2.0 style from legacy style, remove issue of ambiguous sorting
summary: Migrated SQLAlchemy query syntax from 1.4 legacy style to 2.0 style across all repository classes to support future async paradigm adoption. Added a default order-by-id-descending to all queries via the base repository, eliminating the need for redundant sorting throughout the codebase and fixing ambiguous sorting issues in infinite scroll scenarios.
userImpact: Query results now return in consistent descending ID order by default, fixing potential pagination and infinite scroll issues without requiring per-query sort specification.
author: peter496

title: UP-1592: Expand dataset locator concept
summary: Expanded the dataset locator concept by introducing `dataset_locator_schema` to connector specs that defines required locator fields for each connector type, and refactored datasets to consolidate metadata (including `data_file_type`) into a structured `dataset_locator` object. This architectural change removes the standalone `data_file_type` field and establishes a more flexible pattern for connector-specific dataset identification metadata.
userImpact: Frontend contracts are broken; clients must now handle the new `dataset_locator_schema` structure in connector specs and adapted `dataset_locator` objects on datasets, enabling more robust connector-specific dataset identification and validation.
author: alex380125

title: UP-1590 - Break up job_executor.py to smaller pieces
summary: Decomposed the monolithic job_executor.py module into smaller, focused executor classes organized in a job_executors package. The refactoring splits responsibilities into AlertCheckExecutor, ConnectorTestExecutor, FetchDataExecutor, ListDatasetsExecutor, MetricsCalculationExecutor, ScheduleJobsExecutor, and SchemaInferenceExecutor. This structural change improves code maintainability and testability without altering existing functionality.
userImpact: No direct user impact. This refactoring improves code organization and developer experience by making the executor system easier to test and maintain.
author: peter496

title: UP-1597 webhook alert routing
summary: Implemented webhook notification routing that sends alerts to the specific webhooks configured for each alert rule. Also fixed a security issue where alerts could be uploaded for a model using any alert rule ID in the system without validating that the rule belonged to the same model.
userImpact: Users can now configure different webhooks for different alert rules, and alerts will be routed only to the webhooks configured for the rule that triggered them.
author: ianmcgraw

title: UP-1597 alert rule webhook routing
summary: Added API endpoints and database schema to link alert rules to webhooks for notification routing. This is part 1 of a 2-part feature that establishes the data model and API layer; the next MR will integrate these links into the actual alert notification routing logic.
userImpact: Users can now create and manage links between alert rules and webhooks through the API to configure custom notification delivery.
author: ianmcgraw

title: UP-1041 - Add parallelism to dataplane execution
summary: Adds parallel execution to the dataplane by allowing multiple jobs to run concurrently in separate threads or processes. Each job has a memory requirement that must be met before execution, and running jobs are tracked and monitored; when a job completes, its memory allocation is reclaimed. Also makes MemorySecretsClient thread-safe to support parallel integration testing.
userImpact: Users can now run multiple dataplane jobs in parallel within a single agent instance, improving throughput while respecting memory constraints.
author: peter496

title: chore: upsolve update to 0.1.2

title: UP-1435 job queue management design tweaks
summary: Updated job queue management design documentation to add support for moving jobs to the front of the queue (queued-to-queued transition) and corrected a missing state reference in the acceptance criteria. This clarifies the complete set of job state transitions available for queue management operations.
userImpact: Users and developers can now reference accurate job queue state transition documentation, including the move-to-front capability for queued jobs.

title: NO-REF: Use new file for tracking current in memory mock Keycloak client
summary: Fixed race condition in local development environment where multiple processes competed for the same JSON file tracking the in-memory mock Keycloak client. Each process now uses its own temporary file, eliminating the contention and avoiding the need for complex locking mechanisms.
userImpact: Local development with Keycloak mock client now works reliably without race conditions when multiple processes run simultaneously.

title: Add unify-app hosted in vercel origin to CORS
summary: Added the Vercel deployment origin (https://unify-frontend-app.vercel.app) to the CORS allowed origins list in the server configuration. This enables the hosted frontend application to make cross-origin requests to the backend API without being blocked by browser CORS policies.

title: UP-1041 - Initial changes to set up multithreaded job runs
summary: This MR lays the groundwork for multithreaded job execution by adding job priority and memory requirement tracking to the jobs database, introducing a new Cancelled job state, and refactoring the job dequeuing logic to respect agent memory limits. The job submission API now uses a structured argument approach with sensible defaults, reducing configuration burden on callers.
userImpact: Agents can now request jobs that fit within their available memory capacity, and job submissions benefit from simplified configuration with appropriate defaults for internal fields.
author: peter496

title: UP-1435 job queue management tech design
summary: Added a technical design document for job queue management that outlines job states, cancellation and retry behavior, and priority-based queue operations. The document establishes patterns for managing job lifecycle including running, cancellation, retry, and clone tracking to align the team on operational requirements and implementation strategy.
userImpact: Users gain visibility into how job operations like cancellation, retries, and priority-based queue management will be supported and can expect consistent behavior across these workflows.
author: ianmcgraw

title: UP-1582 | Remove task_name from allowed shield filters
summary: Removed the `task_name` filter from the list of allowed filtering fields in the shield connector. This prevents users from filtering by task name, which was unnecessary since the connector already restricts queries to the current task using task ID filtering.
userImpact: Users can no longer filter shield connector queries by task name; filtering is restricted to the current task by task ID only.

summary: Added scripts and infrastructure to generate a sample tabular dataset for the Expel use case and upload it to S3. The new pipeline creates synthetic test data with configurable parameters for number of days and inferences per day, and supports both local file generation and S3 upload. This enables testing and development with realistic data volumes before populating production-scale datasets.
userImpact: Users can now generate and customize sample tabular datasets for testing the Expel model pipeline, with flexible options to create local test files or publish directly to S3.

title: chore: make cpu and memory configurable as parameters
summary: CloudFormation templates for ECS services now expose CPU and memory as configurable parameters instead of hard-coded values, enabling better resource optimization. This allows teams to adjust resource allocations per environment or service without modifying templates, and includes reduced default reservations for the frontend service based on actual usage metrics.
userImpact: Operators can now customize CPU and memory reservations for ECS services via CloudFormation parameters, enabling more cost-efficient deployments aligned with actual service requirements.
author: jdb-arthur

title: Feat redis infra
summary: Introduced Redis Stack infrastructure to the Arthur Scope platform for caching and session storage. The implementation includes Redis subnet groups, serverless cache configuration, cache usage limit support, and secure credential management via CloudFormation secrets. Redis is now deployed alongside the app plane on ECS.
userImpact: Users can now leverage Redis for caching and improved application performance, with configurable cache usage limits and secure credential handling.
author: jdb-arthur

title: NO-REF: Change multiprocessing method from fork to spawn
summary: Changed the multiprocessing start method from fork to spawn to address stability issues in forked processes with multithreaded contexts (FastAPI/Uvicorn). This resolves DeprecationWarnings about fork() usage in multi-threaded processes that could lead to deadlocks. While this introduces a modest performance cost (~2 minutes longer test suite runtime), it should improve CI test stability by eliminating resource-sharing issues caused by fork semantics.
userImpact: CI test suite runs are now more stable and less prone to deadlocks when forking multi-threaded processes.
author: peter496

title: NO-REF: Whitespace changes and python minor version CI change
summary: Updated CI base image to a higher Python minor version to resolve a bug in the current version, along with whitespace normalization across codebase files. These changes ensure CI builds proceed reliably without impacting application code.

title: NO-REF: Roll back user creation on failure
summary: Previously, if updating a user's type in Keycloak failed during user creation, the user would be left in a malformed state without proper role bindings. The bootstrap process would then silently succeed on retry, masking the incomplete setup. This change now rolls back user creation if the Keycloak type update fails, ensuring users are only created when fully initialized.
userImpact: User creation now properly fails and rolls back if the Keycloak type update fails, preventing incomplete user states and bootstrap process masking setup failures.

Each schema node now has a unique ID to support advanced features like field extraction without relying on string-based paths.

title: UP-1471: Fix timestamp typo

userImpact: API requests and responses involving timestamp fields in data retrieval operations now use the correct field name.
author: peter496

title: UP-1471 - Include status and nulled body on GET retrieved data if not loaded.
summary: Modified the GET data retrieval endpoint to include a status field and return a nulled body when data has not yet been loaded or has expired. This change simplifies state management by making the response model more explicit about data availability at the router level, allowing clients to better understand the retrieval state without additional queries.
userImpact: Users can now poll the data retrieval endpoint and receive an explicit status field indicating data availability, with null bodies for unavailable data, enabling more reliable state-driven client logic.
author: peter496

title: NO-REF: Add flags to prevent recursive API models from getting split into input / output
summary: Added flags to FastAPI server configuration to prevent recursive API models from being automatically split into separate Input/Output variants in OpenAPI documentation. This addresses a complex FastAPI behavior where certain combinations of field properties (nullability, defaults) and response_model annotations cause duplicate model definitions, eliminating the need for manual serialization workarounds.
userImpact: API consumers can now define recursive models without worrying about unexpected Input/Output type splitting in OpenAPI specifications.
author: peter496

title: UP-897 | Add permissions check endpoint
summary: Adds a new `/api/v1/permissions/check` endpoint that allows checking permissions for a given resource and permission name in a single bulk operation. This endpoint validates multiple permissions against a resource ID efficiently, eliminating the need for multiple round trips to SpiceDB.
userImpact: Users can now programmatically check whether specific permissions are allowed for a resource via the new permissions check endpoint, enabling more efficient permission validation workflows.
author: ooizig

title: UP-1314 | Add project level jobs filtering based on model_id
summary: This MR adds project-level job filtering based on the model_id field. It introduces a new mechanism to dynamically filter job spec subclasses that have a model_id defined, eliminating the need for manual registration of new model-specific jobs as they're created.
userImpact: Users can now filter jobs at the project level by model_id, with automatic detection of model-specific job types without requiring code updates for each new job variant.
author: ooizig

title: Update dependency anyio to ~=4.6.0

userImpact: Applications using asyncio task groups and cancel scopes will experience improved stability with reduced CPU usage and more consistent cancellation semantics.

title: Update dependency jsdom to v25
summary: Updated the jsdom devDependency from v24 to v25, a major version bump. userImpact: Projects using jsdom with runScripts set to "dangerously" or "outside-only" may experience changes in instanceof behavior due to the isolated prototype chain.

The migration is now idempotent and can be safely re-run.
userImpact: Database migrations no longer stall when removing compliance jobs, allowing the upgrade to complete successfully.

userImpact: Users can now create, assign, list, and delete policies across multiple target models with automatic alert rule materialization, track attestations with required notes fields, and set compliance status with detailed alert/attestation rule results—all with proper permission enforcement and input validation.

title: Add NEEDS_ATTENTION compliance status for enforcement delay period

This informational-only status provides model owners remediation time without triggering webhooks or tags. After the delay expires, violations are automatically promoted to `NON_COMPLIANT` by the daily compliance job.
userImpact: Model owners can now see assignments in `NEEDS_ATTENTION` during the grace period, giving them time to remediate violations before enforcement is triggered.

Additionally, PATCH and DELETE operations on policy-managed alert rules are now blocked to prevent unintended modifications.
userImpact: Users can now filter policy assignments, alert rules, and attestations by assignment and validation status, and policy-managed alert rules are protected from direct modification through the API.

title: UP-2379 create internal connectors on data plane project association

userImpact: Users can now automatically leverage data planes in their projects without manual connector setup, and the system prevents accidental removal of data planes that have active dependencies.
author: ianmcgraw

title: UP-2219: Add engine name validation
summary: Added engine name validation to the backend data planes and users operators. New validation rules are implemented in the validation module to ensure engine names meet requirements before being persisted, with comprehensive test coverage for both data plane and user validation scenarios.
userImpact: Users can now create and manage data planes with validated engine names that conform to system requirements.
author: alex380125

title: UP-2378 & UP-2380 hide engine internal connectors and datasets
summary: Updated the connectors and datasets APIs to hide engine internal connector resources and datasets by default. This prevents internal infrastructure resources from being exposed in user-facing views while maintaining backward compatibility through the repository and operator layers.
userImpact: Users no longer see internal engine connectors and their associated datasets in the connectors and datasets API responses, reducing clutter in model management interfaces.
author: ianmcgraw

title: [no-ref] fix email settings passing to bootstrap CFT
summary: Email configuration values were not being passed to the bootstrap CloudFormation Template, causing warnings in deployment logs about missing authentication email reply-to settings. This fix ensures all email settings from environment config are properly forwarded to the bootstrap stack.

author: ianmcgraw

title: chore: add timescale daily backups for ec2 images/amis
summary: Added daily automated backups for the TimeScale EC2 instance by creating daily AMI snapshots. Since PostgreSQL data resides on the root volume, this provides a straightforward backup and restore solution for the database.
userImpact: Users now have daily automated backups of the TimeScale database that can be used for disaster recovery and restoring previous database states.
author: jdb-arthur

title: UP-2377 internal connector
summary: Added a new `engine_internal` connector type that mirrors Shield's functionality but retrieves credentials from the data plane's environment variables instead of the platform. The connector type is hidden from the API response to prevent it from appearing in the frontend, as it is used internally for Shield API key management jobs.
userImpact: The system can now use environment-based credentials for internal connector operations, enabling Shield API key management workflows without exposing the internal connector type to users.
author: ianmcgraw

title: UP-2290: Add API to retrieve feature flags
summary: Added a new API endpoint to retrieve all feature flags for the application. The endpoint returns a JSON object containing all feature flag names and their current values, eliminating the need for individual feature flag endpoints and allowing future feature flags to be automatically consumable by the frontend without requiring backend changes.
userImpact: Users and frontend clients can now retrieve all feature flags in a single API call, enabling dynamic feature flag consumption without backend modifications.
author: alex380125

title: UP-2315: Update org bootstrap to use immutable org identifier
summary: Updated the organization bootstrap process to use an immutable organization identifier instead of recreating default organizations. The change prevents default organizations from being re-created during bootstrap runs when new default organization IDs are added to the configuration, ensuring idempotent behavior. Unit tests validate that the bootstrap job correctly skips re-creation of existing default organizations.
userImpact: Default organizations are no longer recreated during bootstrap operations, preventing unintended duplicate organization creation and ensuring consistent organization lifecycle management.
author: alex380125

title: XP-1556: Add variable to control fetching raw data
summary: Added an environment variable to control whether raw data fetching is enabled in the data plane. This feature allows operators to disable raw data access at deployment time through configuration, providing more granular control over sensitive data exposure. The change includes updates to CloudFormation, Docker Compose, application configuration, and deployment environments.
userImpact: Users can now control raw data fetching behavior through environment variables configured at deployment time, enabling fine-grained access control for sensitive data.
author: kacper.krupinski

title: fix: timescale port log in deployment script
summary: The deployment script was logging the timescale hostname instead of the port in a debug log line. This fix corrects the log output to display the actual port number, improving deployment troubleshooting visibility.
userImpact: Deployment logs now correctly show the timescale port instead of the hostname, making it easier to debug deployment configuration issues.
author: jdb-arthur

title: UP-2291: Create new user via email
summary: Implemented new user creation and invitation via email, allowing administrators to invite new users without requiring password setup. The system now supports assigning invited users to multiple groups and role bindings across organization, workspace, and project scopes through a unified invitation workflow. This includes updates to the authorization schema, user models, and invitation operators to manage pending permissions and group assignments.
userImpact: Administrators can now invite new users by email and assign them to multiple groups or role-based permissions at different organizational levels, without requiring the invitees to set passwords upfront.
author: alex380125

title: UP-2383 update upsolve and new export
summary: Upgraded Upsolve to the latest release, introducing a new multiclass model dashboard and a new chart component for adding text descriptions to dashboards. These improvements enhance the monitoring and visualization capabilities for multiclass model problem types.
userImpact: Users can now view and monitor multiclass models with a dedicated dashboard and add descriptive text annotations to their dashboards.
author: ianmcgraw

title: UP-2066 tech design for task API key management

userImpact: No direct user impact

title: UP-2315: Temporarily support user claims with or without org ID included

title: Hotfix/byo timescale

userImpact: Users can now configure and deploy with external Timescale instances by providing BYO_TIMESCALE_HOST and BYO_TIMESCALE_INSTANCE_ID parameters, decoupling from the managed Timescale stack.

title: UP-2242 Fix Query Slowness by removing old metric versions
summary: Implemented automatic deletion of old metric versions when new versions are uploaded, preventing metric query slowdowns caused by accumulating historical versions. This addresses a production issue where Axios's dashboard loaded in over a minute due to hundreds of thousands of unused metric versions accumulating in the database over a 2-week window.
userImpact: Metrics queries now complete significantly faster by removing obsolete metric versions, resolving the dashboard slowness experienced by customers like Axios.

title: UP-2315: Add organization user-friendly display name
summary: Added organization user-friendly display name capability by introducing an `auth_org_id` field synced from Keycloak organization claims. This enables the system to use organization IDs as immutable identifiers while supporting human-readable display names in Keycloak for user-facing communications like email invites. The implementation includes database migrations, updates to authentication/authorization layers, and refactoring of Keycloak client logic for thread-safe organization caching.
userImpact: Organizations can now have user-friendly display names that appear in email invites and communications, while the system internally uses stable organization IDs for secure resource access management.

The previous validation had issues with the regex pattern and was unnecessarily restrictive; the updated pattern now allows non-English characters and numbers while blocking only reserved characters that would break URL compatibility.
userImpact: Organizations can now be created with names containing non-English characters, numbers at the start, and hyphens, as long as they don't contain URL-reserved characters.

The fix enqueues deep copies of deleted objects to the delete queues instead of the original objects, ensuring deletions persist correctly even when flush is called.

userImpact: Users can now create organizations with names containing non-English characters, hyphens, and numbers at the start, provided they don't contain reserved URL characters.

This prevents job loss and race conditions during container drainage events.
userImpact: ECS task shutdowns are now handled gracefully, ensuring running jobs complete when possible and failed jobs are properly reported, preventing data loss and inconsistent job states during container lifecycle events.

title: UP-1600 - UP-1654 - UP-1430 - Move SQLAlchemy code to 2.0 style from legacy style, remove issue of ambiguous sorting
summary: Migrated database layer from SQLAlchemy 1.4 legacy `.query()` style to modern 2.0 API across all repository classes. This migration is a prerequisite for adopting async paradigms and centralizes query handling for better maintainability. Additionally, all queries now default to ordering by ID descending, eliminating the need for scattered double-sort implementations in infinite scroll scenarios and reducing future sorting-related bugs.
userImpact: Users benefit from more reliable pagination and sorting behavior in infinite scroll interfaces, while the codebase is now positioned to adopt async database operations in the future.

Removed the `data_file_type` field from datasets and integrated it into the `dataset_locator` structure, allowing locator fields to be dynamically defined per connector type. Database migration included to restructure existing data.
userImpact: Frontend contracts are broken; datasets now have dataset locators with connector-specific field schemas instead of a fixed data_file_type field, enabling flexible dataset identification across different connector types.

title: UP-1590 - Break up job_executor.py to smaller pieces

This refactoring improves code maintainability and testability without altering any functionality.
userImpact: No direct user impact.

title: UP-1041 - Add parallelism to dataplane execution
summary: Adds parallel execution to the dataplane job agent, allowing multiple jobs to run concurrently in separate threads or processes. The dequeuing endpoint now accepts agent memory capacity in the request body and filters jobs accordingly, while `JobsRepository.submit_job` now uses a struct pattern with sensible defaults for internal fields like retry count and timestamps.
userImpact: Agents can now communicate their available memory capacity and receive only jobs that fit within their resource limits, enabling safer concurrent job execution without overloading individual workers.

While `spawn` has slightly lower performance (~2 minutes longer test runs), it is more stable and reduces test flakiness caused by fork-related issues.
userImpact: No direct user impact; improves CI test stability and reliability.

The previously separate columns.tsx file from RolesByEntity was not being utilized, so its functionality has been integrated directly into the wrapper components.
userImpact: No direct user impact; internal code organization improvement for maintainability.
author: sergai

title: UP-1598 add alert rule webhook notification state management
summary: Adds webhook notification state management for alert rules through new multi-select dropdown components in the alert rule creation and editing flows. Users can now assign multiple notification webhooks to alert rules, with visibility of configured webhooks on both the view and summary pages. Webhook names are clickable links for easy navigation to webhook details.
userImpact: Users can now select and manage notification webhooks when creating or editing alert rules, and view all assigned webhooks from the alert rule detail and summary pages.
author: ianmcgraw

title: UP-898: ReBAC context
summary: Introduces ReBAC (Relationship-Based Access Control) context infrastructure for permission management. Adds new services and utilities including a RebacContext provider, useHasPermissions hook, and Can component to enable fine-grained permission checking throughout the application. Includes e2e test coverage for permission validation scenarios.
userImpact: Users can now benefit from relationship-based access control with proper permission enforcement across the application interface based on their roles and relationships.
author: sergai

title: NO-REF: i18n fix
summary: Fixed internationalization (i18n) issue in the CustomRangeShortcut component. Updated translation strings and dependencies to ensure proper localization support across the UI package.
userImpact: Users now see correctly localized text in the CustomRangeShortcut component across all supported languages.
author: sergai

title: NO-REF: Fix parser for activity logs
summary: Fixed a parser bug in the activity logs filtering logic. The parseFilters utility was corrected to properly handle activity log entries, ensuring filters are applied correctly when retrieving log data.
userImpact: Users can now correctly filter and view activity logs without parser errors.
author: sergai

title: Add vercel.json to allow it to use SPAs
summary: Added vercel.json configuration file to enable Single Page Application (SPA) support on Vercel deployments. This allows the deployment to properly handle client-side routing without requiring server-side configuration changes, following Vercel's documentation for Vite-based SPAs.
userImpact: Deployments to Vercel now correctly handle client-side routing in Single Page Applications without 404 errors on direct navigation.
author: zach.fry

title: UP-1587: UI i18n fix
summary: Fixed internationalization (i18n) issues in the UI components affecting the ModelRefreshModal, CustomRangeShortcut, and translation strings. Changes include correcting translation keys in English locale files and adjusting helper functions to properly reference i18n strings.
userImpact: Users will now see correctly translated UI text in affected components where i18n keys were previously misaligned.
author: sergai

title: UP-1327: Mutate key
summary: Updated the infinite query mutation key handling across multiple schedule and activity log components. The changes refactor how mutation keys are found and applied for API calls, improving consistency in cache invalidation for scheduled jobs and activity log operations.
userImpact: No direct user impact—internal optimization of data synchronization for schedule and activity log mutations.
author: sergai

title: UP-1474 - Low lift UX changes
summary: This MR delivers several UX improvements across the application: users can now navigate out of the onboarding flow, organization-level binding has been added to the RolesByEntity view, the copy password button text has been corrected, and a "modified by" header has been added with a fix for name updates not reflecting in the UI immediately.
userImpact: Users gain better control during onboarding, can see who last modified records, and experience more accurate UI updates for name changes and copy-to-clipboard feedback.
author: marcin.szczepaniak

title: UP-1572: Raw data retrieval e2e tests
summary: Added end-to-end tests for raw data retrieval functionality in Cypress, including test fixtures for completed and running data retrieval job states. The tests validate the data retrieval workflow across the inference deep dive interface.
userImpact: No direct user impact
author: sergai

title: UP-1572: Filter state and pagination fix
summary: Fixed filter state handling and pagination behavior in the Inference tables. The changes address state management issues in the InferencesTableWrapper and InferenceDeepDiveTable components, ensuring that filter selections and pagination state are correctly maintained across user interactions.
userImpact: Users will now see correct pagination and filter state behavior when navigating and filtering inference results.
author: sergai

title: UP-1572: raw data retrieval cleaning
summary: Removed the unused `useRawDataRetrieval` hook from the raw data retrieval API and cleaned up related dependencies. Updated the DeepDiveToolbar component and TypeScript configuration to remove references to the deprecated hook, reducing code complexity and maintenance burden.
userImpact: No direct user impact; internal cleanup removing unused code patterns and dependencies.
author: sergai

title: Fix lint
summary: Fixed a linting issue in the main TypeScript entry point. This is a minor code quality improvement with no functional changes.
userImpact: No direct user impact
author: zach.fry

title: [UP-1137] - replace graphana dashboard with upsolve
summary: Replaced the Grafana dashboard integration with Upsolve, a new observability solution. The integration now fetches authentication tokens from the backend API endpoint instead of directly from Upsolve, improving security and reducing frontend exposure to API keys. Updated dependencies, configuration, and tests to support the new dashboard component.
userImpact: Users can now view model analytics and monitoring through the Upsolve dashboard interface instead of Grafana within the model details page.
author: marcin.szczepaniak

title: UP-1327: Mutate for infinite keys
summary: Added `findInfiniteMutateKey` utility to enable mutations on infinite query caches using partial argument matching. This allows developers to revalidate paginated data without needing to pass all original query parameters, simplifying cache invalidation patterns for infinite lists.
userImpact: Developers can now efficiently mutate infinite query caches by matching on a subset of arguments, reducing boilerplate when updating paginated data across the application.
author: sergai

title: Filter duplicate data entries and sort by time in AlertPerformanceGraph
summary: AlertPerformanceGraph now filters duplicate data entries and sorts them by time. This ensures the graph displays accurate, chronologically-ordered performance metrics without redundant data points that could skew visual analysis.
userImpact: Users will now see a cleaner AlertPerformanceGraph with deduplicated data points displayed in correct chronological order.
author: marcin.szczepaniak

title: [UP-993] - logs whitespaces
summary: Job logs now display whitespaces visually, making it easier to debug formatting and spacing issues in log output. This change improves log readability by rendering whitespace characters that were previously hidden.
userImpact: Users can now see whitespace characters (spaces, tabs, etc.) rendered visibly in job logs, helping identify spacing-related issues in their output.
author: marcin.szczepaniak

title: UP-1206: Model dashboard accepts time filters from URL query string
summary: The model dashboard now accepts time and date filters from URL query string parameters. This allows users to share dashboard links with pre-configured time ranges, improving collaboration and bookmarking of specific time windows. The implementation reads query parameters on component initialization and passes them as initial state values to the dashboard filters.
userImpact: Users can now pass time filters via URL query strings (e.g., ?startDate=X&endDate=Y) to load the model dashboard with pre-selected date ranges.
author: sergai

title: [UP-1353, UP-760] - onboarding listing datasets changes
summary: Implemented automatic dataset listing during onboarding with SWR polling-based state management. The system now automatically initiates a list datasets job on first fetch if no datasets are present, and provides improved error handling and recovery mechanisms. Changed from promise-based polling to SWR hooks for more reliable state synchronization.
userImpact: Users can now seamlessly discover and list available datasets during the onboarding flow without manual intervention, with better error recovery if initial attempts fail.
author: marcin.szczepaniak

title: [UP-1214] [FE] As an Arthur UI user, I want to see raw data in the inference deep dive tab
summary: Added raw data display functionality to the inference deep dive tab in Arthur UI. The implementation includes a new data retrieval hook, filter parsing, date range selection, and column visibility controls. Supporting components like NoRowsOverlay were refactored into the shared package for reuse across the application.
userImpact: Users can now view and interact with raw inference data in the inference deep dive tab, with support for filtering, date range selection, and customizable column visibility.
author: kapotyrala-arthur

title: UP-1433: Deleting a project, UP-1434: Deleting a model
summary: Added functionality to delete projects and models from the UI. Users can now remove projects and models through new delete dialogs with confirmation, backed by new i18n translations and comprehensive Cypress tests for both workflows.
userImpact: Users can now delete projects and models directly from the application interface with proper confirmation prompts.
author: sergai

title: Add meticulous and record interactions w/ scope.dev.arthur.ai
summary: Added Meticulous integration to record user interactions during development on scope.dev.arthur.ai. The integration includes installation of the Meticulous recorder library and conditional initialization based on hostname detection, allowing developers to capture and replay user sessions for debugging and testing purposes.
userImpact: Developers can now record and replay user interactions on the development environment to improve debugging and test coverage.
author: zach.fry

title: NO-REF: QA fixes (UP-1389, UP-1366, UP-1371, UP-1457)
summary: Multiple QA issues have been resolved across management table and role components. Changes include fixing failed job text color visibility in JobStatus, updating table wrapper styling and column configurations in organization/project/workspace/role management views, and removing unused code from RolesByEntity component.
userImpact: Users will see correct styling in job status indicators and properly formatted management tables for organizations, projects, workspaces, and roles.
author: sergai

title: UP-1458: Hide nav bar for org level
summary: Navigation bar is now hidden when viewing organization-level content. Changes to the layout component and drawer content ensure the nav bar is conditionally rendered based on the current context level.
userImpact: Users viewing organization-level pages will no longer see the navigation bar in those contexts.
author: sergai

title: [UP-1496] - Chart changes
summary: Chart rendering now begins at the earliest available timestamp from query results or the selected timerange, whichever is earlier. Fixed boundary display issue when no items cross the threshold and adjusted the default timerange to start 2 weeks back and end 4 hours ahead (rounded to the hour).
userImpact: Users now see more accurate and properly-aligned chart visualizations with corrected boundary rendering and sensible default time windows.
author: marcin.szczepaniak

title: [UP-1300] [FE] Date/ time selectors behaviour not behaving as expected - QA FIX
summary: Fixed date/time selector modal behavior by correcting the default `from` value to match the last updated timestamp. Also corrected the `publish-ui` CI job configuration to properly trigger when UI package files are modified.
userImpact: Date/time selectors in modals now correctly initialize with the expected default value, resolving unexpected behavior previously reported by QA.
author: kapotyrala-arthur

title: UP-1445: Workpace loader for webhooks routes
summary: Implemented a workspace loader for webhook routes that ensures proper workspace context is available when accessing webhook-related pages. The change simplifies route handling by centralizing workspace loading logic for webhooks, reducing conditional checks in the AppRoutes component. Test coverage was expanded across multiple features to validate the workspace loader functionality.
userImpact: Users can now reliably access webhook management pages with proper workspace context automatically loaded, preventing navigation errors and improving the reliability of webhook route handling.
author: sergai

title: Release readiness QA tweaks
summary: This release includes QA and UX refinements focused on error messaging and UI polish. Changes include improved error messages when assigning groups and roles after creation, refined webhook error handling, variable breadcrumbs in job logs, and corrected labels in the onboarding flow. These tweaks enhance clarity and consistency across the application interface.
userImpact: Users will see clearer, more contextual error messages when managing group memberships and role assignments, improved webhook test feedback, and better navigation context in job logs.
author: marcin.szczepaniak

title: [UP-1315] - Model specific activity logs
summary: Added model-specific activity logs accessible as a new tab in the model detail view. This enhancement allows users to view and track the history of jobs and activities associated with a specific model, improving observability and debugging capabilities.
userImpact: Users can now access activity logs directly from a model's detail page via a dedicated tab, making it easier to track model-related jobs and operations.
author: marcin.szczepaniak

title: UP-1407: Create workspace button
summary: Added a "Create workspace" button to improve workspace management in the UI. The button integrates with the existing workspace modal and project creation flows, enabling users to quickly initiate new workspace creation from the application layout.
userImpact: Users can now create new workspaces directly via a dedicated button in the application interface.
author: sergai

title: UP-1414: Disable workspace creating button
summary: The workspace creation button has been disabled in the product UI. This change prevents users from creating new workspaces through the interface, affecting both the subHeader and workspaceSelector components.
userImpact: Users can no longer create new workspaces via the workspace creation button in the UI.
author: sergai

title: UP-1420: Data source: hide sensitve keys on confirmation screen
summary: Sensitive data source credential keys are now hidden on the data source confirmation screen during the onboarding flow. This prevents accidental exposure of authentication credentials in the UI confirmation step, improving security when users review their data source configuration.
userImpact: Users will no longer see sensitive API keys or credentials displayed on the data source confirmation screen during onboarding.
author: sergai

title: UP-1426: Workspace overview with dropdown menu
summary: Added a workspace overview dropdown menu that allows users to quickly navigate between and manage workspaces. The feature includes a new workspacesMenu component integrated into the drawer navigation and updates to the shared Menu component to support this new workspace selection interface.
userImpact: Users can now access a dropdown menu in the workspace overview to switch between workspaces and view workspace-related options more conveniently.
author: sergai

title: fix: do not copy Dockerfiles into image so dockerfile changes do not trigger a...
summary: This MR improves Docker build efficiency and reliability by excluding Dockerfiles from the image build context, preventing unnecessary rebuilds when Dockerfile changes occur. It also adds an nginx configuration validation step at build time to catch config errors early, and configures nginx to listen on both port 80 and port 3023 to support both AWS and JD environments.
userImpact: Users benefit from faster local development cycles as Dockerfile changes no longer trigger full node rebuilds, and nginx configuration errors are caught during image build rather than at runtime.
author: jdb-arthur

title: feat: add a listener on 3023 to match aws sg configuration and allow...
summary: Added an nginx listener on port 3023 to match AWS security group configuration and allow healthchecks from the load balancer. This ensures the load balancer can properly communicate with the application for health monitoring.
userImpact: Load balancer healthchecks can now successfully reach the application on port 3023, enabling proper load balancer integration.
author: jdb-arthur

title: Release readiness 2
summary: This release readiness update includes three targeted fixes and improvements. It resolves an infinite loading issue that occurred on re-focus by revalidating the first page, improves error handling in new user creation flows, and enhances webhook testing error messaging with better user-facing feedback.
userImpact: Users will no longer experience infinite loading when returning to a focused view, new user creation errors are now handled more gracefully, and webhook testing provides clearer error messages.
author: marcin.szczepaniak

title: NO-REF: Add node options var bumping heap space
summary: Builds were intermittently failing with JavaScript heap out of memory errors during the build process. A Node.js options variable has been added to the CI configuration to increase heap space allocation, allowing builds to complete successfully even with memory-intensive operations.
userImpact: Build failures due to heap memory exhaustion are resolved, ensuring reliable and consistent build execution.
author: peter496

title: Release readiness part 1
summary: This release readiness update includes UI refinements, bug fixes, and improvements across onboarding, data sources, and job management. Changes include adding a connectorType field to datasource basic info, sorting job logs, limiting character counts in user and group creation forms, fixing button loading states, and improving modal scaling on smaller devices.
userImpact: Users benefit from improved form validation with character limits, clearer UI labels, better modal responsiveness on mobile devices, and more reliable button state handling in onboarding and project flows.
author: marcin.szczepaniak

title: UP-1379 - Activity log UX improvements
summary: Improved activity log UX with several refinements: job type filters now display human-readable strings with multiselect capability, jobs table columns have been reorganized to hide contextually unnecessary fields, and scheduled jobs are hidden from all job tables. Filters for scheduled jobs have been updated to use type=metrics with ready_after=now() to reduce clutter and better reflect the user experience.
userImpact: Users can now multiselect job types with clearer labels, see more relevant columns in job tables, and no longer see scheduled jobs as they are now filtered as implementation details.
author: peter496

title: Up 1344 alerts updates
summary: Comprehensive updates to alerts functionality including enhanced infinite-scroll pagination with the new useApiInfinite hook, improved AlertDetails page with trigger point visualization, and updated alert rule editing. Additionally includes webhook validation, performance graph improvements, and broader API pagination support across multiple table wrappers.
userImpact: Users can now browse alerts and other large data sets with improved infinite-scroll pagination, see where alerts were triggered in the details view, and manage alert rules with better validation and a modernized UI.
author: marcin.szczepaniak

title: [UP-1425] [FE] Create Shared Package for Components
summary: Created a shared UI package for reusable components that can be consumed across the monorepo and published to a private package registry. The solution includes manual versioning and publishing workflows, shared TypeScript configuration and types packages, unit tests for components, and manual translations management. This enables component reuse without local installation in the monorepo.
userImpact: Development teams can now extract and reuse common UI components, types, and configurations across multiple applications via a published shared package.
author: kapotyrala-arthur

title: [UP-1300] [FE] Date/ time selectors behaviour not behaving as expected
summary: Fixed date/time selector behaviour in the data refresh modal where the "Last Updated At" timestamp was not being updated and modal inputs could become null after submission. The fixes ensure the modal re-renders on open to fetch fresh dates and provides default values to prevent null inputs.
userImpact: The data refresh modal now correctly displays updated timestamps and maintains valid input values after submission.
author: kapotyrala-arthur

title: [UP-1413] [FE] Handle password policy errors on frontend
summary: Added a utility function to extract `error_description` from password policy error strings on the frontend. This enables the user creation form to properly parse and display password policy validation errors returned from the backend.
userImpact: Users now see clearer password policy error messages when creating new user accounts.
author: kapotyrala-arthur

title: Up 1344 alerts updates
summary: Comprehensive refactor and enhancement of the alerts system, including restructuring alert rule pages under the models hierarchy, improvements to the alert details view with trigger point marking, implementation of infinite scrolling for the alerts table, and validation for webhook URLs. The performance graph x-axis now reflects selected time ranges and displays additional metric columns with improved sorting in the metrics modal.
userImpact: Users can now view alerts with better pagination performance, edit alert rules with improved validation, see more detailed information in metrics results, and better understand alert performance with an x-axis that correctly represents their selected time range.
author: marcin.szczepaniak

title: UP-1384: Nav bar tests
summary: Added comprehensive end-to-end tests for the navigation bar drawer component, including selector improvements and fixes for menu behavior. Changes include updates to appBar, layout, and Menu components to support the new test suite.
userImpact: No direct user impact
author: sergai

title: UP-1319 update time options
summary: Updated time range shortcut options in the Model Refresh Modal to match the specifications defined in UP-1319. This includes changes to the modal's helper functions and corresponding internationalization strings to provide users with the updated time range choices.
userImpact: Users can now select from an updated set of time range shortcuts when refreshing models.
author: vivienmarcolin

title: UP-1164 Pin actions column
summary: The actions column in the Group Table is now pinned to the viewport and made non-resizable, ensuring it remains visible when scrolling horizontally through table data. This improves usability by keeping critical action buttons always accessible without requiring users to scroll back.
userImpact: Users can now always see and access the actions column in the Group Table while scrolling horizontally without the column being resizable.
author: vivienmarcolin

title: UP-1378 Errors when creating users
summary: Fixed user creation error messaging to properly display backend errors. The system now shows a specific error message when a 409 conflict is returned (user already exists) and exposes detailed error messages for 400 validation errors (e.g., password requirements).
userImpact: Users now receive clear, actionable error messages when user creation fails due to existing accounts or unmet password requirements.
author: vivienmarcolin

title: UP-1252 single select for tasks table
summary: Modified the tasks table to enforce single-row selection, preventing users from selecting multiple rows simultaneously. This improves the user experience by clarifying the selection model and aligning with expected behavior for single-item operations.
userImpact: Users can now select only one row at a time in the tasks/datasets table, providing clearer interaction patterns.
author: vivienmarcolin

title: UP-1242 design changes
summary: Added missing axis label to the alert performance chart and improved visual formatting of axis ticks. These design refinements enhance the clarity and usability of the chart display in the alert configuration interface.
userImpact: Users can now see properly labeled axes and better formatted tick marks on the alert performance chart, improving chart readability.
author: vivienmarcolin

title: [UP-1127, 1129, 1130, 1336] - Webhooks table and edit states, webhook creation bugfixes
summary: Added a webhooks management table with the ability to view, edit, and delete webhooks. Implemented webhook editing functionality including name editing and loading states, along with fixes to the webhook creation flow and navigation. Added new webhook test utilities and improved UI consistency across webhook views.
userImpact: Users can now view all webhooks in a table, edit webhook names and configurations, and navigate smoothly through the webhook creation and management flows.
author: marcin.szczepaniak

title: Update jitesoft/node-yarn Docker tag to v21
summary: Updated jitesoft/node-yarn Docker image tag from v20 to v21. This is a major version upgrade for the Node.js and Yarn base image used in the project's build environment.
userImpact: The build environment now uses Node.js/Yarn v21, providing access to the latest features and improvements in the Node ecosystem.
author: group_3720083_bot_bf89c4e378f22b6cb8b2f93b06d47dae

title: Update dependency react-i18next to v15
summary: Updated react-i18next from v14 to v15, bringing modern JavaScript features, build optimizations, and React 19 compatibility fixes. The major version includes support for optional chaining and nullish coalescing, along with bug fixes for the Trans component's list rendering and format handling.
userImpact: Users benefit from improved React 19 compatibility and bug fixes for translation component rendering, ensuring consistent key prop handling in lists.
author: group_3720083_bot_bf89c4e378f22b6cb8b2f93b06d47dae

title: UP-1257 Tasks table
summary: Added pagination, server-side filtering by name, and server-side sorting to the tasks/available datasets table. The implementation refactored the data fetching approach to use SWR for improved state management and reduced unnecessary API calls.
userImpact: Users can now navigate large task datasets using pagination, search tasks by name, and sort results by name for improved discoverability and navigation.
author: vivienmarcolin

title: NO-REF: Remove overwrite of docker credentials
summary: Removed duplicate docker-start step execution that was overwriting ECR credentials between docker-build-and-publish-main and docker-build-and-publish-template jobs. The docker-start step was being run twice, causing the credentials generated in the first run to be overwritten by the second run.
userImpact: Docker credential handling in CI/CD pipelines now works correctly without credentials being overwritten between build steps.
author: peter496

title: NO-REF: Add docker auth to docker steps
summary: Added Docker authentication configuration to Docker build steps in the CI/CD pipeline. This ensures that Docker commands have proper credentials when pulling or pushing images, preventing authentication failures during the build process.
userImpact: No direct user impact
author: peter496

title: UP-1269: Slide in drawer content
summary: Refactored drawer content to slide in from the side by extracting drawer logic into a dedicated drawerContent component and restructuring the appBar and layout components. The changes improve component separation of concerns and enable animated slide-in behavior for the drawer UI.
userImpact: Users can now see drawer content slide in smoothly instead of appearing instantly, providing a more polished and responsive UI experience.
author: sergai

title: Update dependency jsdom to v25
summary: Updated jsdom development dependency from v24.1.3 to v25.0.0, a major version bump that changes the prototype chain of EventTarget in jsdom to stay entirely within the jsdom realm rather than crossing into the Node.js realm when runScripts is set to non-default values. This may cause minor changes in instanceof behavior but should have minimal impact on most programs.
userImpact: No direct user impact.
author: group_3720083_bot_bf89c4e378f22b6cb8b2f93b06d47dae

title: Update cypress/base Docker tag to v22
summary: Updated the cypress/base Docker image from v20.18.0 to v22.7.0 in the CI/CD configuration. This is a major version upgrade that brings newer Node.js and system dependencies to the test environment, enabling access to recent language features and security updates.
userImpact: CI/CD pipelines now use a newer version of the cypress/base Docker image with updated Node.js and system libraries, ensuring tests run on a current platform.
author: group_3720083_bot_bf89c4e378f22b6cb8b2f93b06d47dae

title: Update all non-major dependencies
summary: Automated dependency updates applied across the project to non-major versions, including minor and patch updates to core libraries such as Emotion, Material-UI, CodeMirror, ESLint, and Fontsource packages. These updates bring in the latest compatible improvements and security patches without breaking changes.
userImpact: Users benefit from the latest library improvements, bug fixes, and security updates while maintaining full compatibility with the application.
author: group_3720083_bot_bf89c4e378f22b6cb8b2f93b06d47dae

title: UP-1081 renovate bot changes
summary: Updated Renovate bot configuration to group all minor and patch dependency updates into a single merge request, enable auto-merging, assign FE team members for awareness, and remove rate limits to ensure all dependencies are updated. This reduces merge conflicts and streamlines the dependency update workflow.
userImpact: No direct user impact
author: ianmcgraw

title: [UP-1338] [FE] Create a seconds to proper unit parser for scheduled jobs
summary: Added a seconds-to-proper-unit parser for scheduled jobs in the form editing state. The changes update the DataRefreshForm schema and ExistingScheduleForm to display time intervals in human-readable units (e.g., minutes, hours) instead of raw seconds.
userImpact: Users can now see scheduled job intervals displayed in readable time units rather than seconds, making it easier to configure and understand data refresh settings.
author: kapotyrala-arthur

title: UP-1268 Multi Drop down menu
summary: Implemented a multi-level dropdown menu component for the new navigation bar, allowing users to navigate through hierarchical menu structures with proper expand/collapse interactions. This includes a reusable Menu component with support for nested items, tooltips, and responsive styling.
userImpact: Users can now access project and workspace navigation through an intuitive multi-level dropdown menu in the new navigation bar.
author: sergai

title: [UP-1332] [FE] Update onboarding flow to create model before confirmation step so that we can reuse it's details for parts of the onboarding
summary: The onboarding flow now creates the model during the tasks step instead of the confirmation step, enabling the data refresh step to reuse the model's details. This improves the onboarding experience by allowing users to configure data refresh schedules with the model already initialized.
userImpact: Users can now set up data refresh scheduling during onboarding with access to the newly created model's details for configuration.
author: kapotyrala-arthur

title: [UP-1140] [FE] Add job log attempt # to API call
summary: The job log page now supports multiple job attempts and includes attempt number in API calls. Users can switch between different attempts, with the first attempt set as the default, enabling better visibility into job execution history.
userImpact: Users can now view and switch between different job attempts on the activity log page to debug and monitor job execution across multiple runs.
author: kapotyrala-arthur

title: UP-1242 Alert Rule Metric Name
summary: Added the ability to specify a custom metric name when creating alert rules. The metric name is now displayed on both the alert rule configuration page and alert details pages, providing greater clarity and customization for alert management.
userImpact: Users can now assign and view custom metric names for alert rules, improving alert rule organization and clarity across the alert management interface.
author: vivienmarcolin

title: UP-1254 New Navigation bar
summary: Replaced the sidebar navigation with a new navigation bar featuring a collapsible drawer, multi-level dropdown menus, and an updated theme. This consolidates three approved feature branches into a cohesive navigation redesign that improves the overall application layout and user navigation experience.
userImpact: Users now have access to a modernized navigation interface with a slide-in drawer, multi-dropdown menu support, and refreshed visual theme for improved usability and navigation clarity.
author: sergai

title: UP-1267 New theme
summary: This MR introduces a new theme and layout to support the upcoming navigation bar redesign. It replaces the sidebar-based navigation with an app bar component, updates spacing and styling across the application, and refactors related layout components to work with the new navigation structure.
userImpact: Users will see a redesigned navigation interface with a new app bar layout and updated visual styling as part of the upcoming navigation bar rollout.
author: sergai

title: UP-1266 date format issues
summary: Fixed date formatting to use 12-hour format instead of 24-hour format throughout the application. Added missing translation string for "updated at" to ensure consistent localization across date-related UI elements.
userImpact: Users now see dates displayed in 12-hour format with proper AM/PM indicators, and the "updated at" label is correctly translated in the application.
author: vivienmarcolin

title: NO-REF: granulate workspaces tests
summary: Updated workspace end-to-end tests to improve test coverage and granularity. This change refines the Cypress test suite for workspace functionality without altering product behavior.
userImpact: No direct user impact
author: sergai

title: [UP-1106, UP-1255, UP-1259, UP-1260] - Alert rules testing functionality, QA fixes
summary: Improved alert rule testing functionality with multiple bug fixes and QA enhancements. Changes include fixing table height and sorting behavior, adding line numbers to the code editor, fixing threshold value handling, and adding an alert performance graph to the metrics modal. Also resolved data revalidation issues with the alert rules table to ensure newly created rules appear in the correct order.
userImpact: Users can now test alert rules more effectively with a properly functioning metrics modal that displays performance graphs, correctly persisted threshold values, and alert rules appearing in the proper order without requiring page refreshes.
author: marcin.szczepaniak

title: UP-1119: useSWRInfinite
summary: Introduces useSWRInfinite hook for paginated API requests, enabling efficient infinite scroll and pagination patterns. The new useApiInfinite hook wraps SWR's useSWRInfinite to flatten paginated responses and integrate with the existing API client infrastructure.
userImpact: Users can now implement infinite scroll and paginated table views using the useApiInfinite hook, simplifying the integration of paginated API responses throughout the application.
author: sergai

title: [UP-1128] - Add a new webhook flow

V1 now applies name validation to all PERSON spans, and V2's validation was tightened to reject any name token containing a digit instead of only when all tokens contain digits. A single shared validator change fixes both code paths.
userImpact: PII detection accuracy for PERSON entities improves from 85% to 100% on the test set, with false-positive rate dropping from 17.9% to 0%, eliminating spurious detection of flight numbers and regulation codes as personal names.

The fix proactively creates `ix_job_errors_job_run_id` and `ix_job_logs_job_run_id` indexes before deletions begin, converting verification from sequential scans to fast index probes and reducing batch time from minutes to sub-seconds. Verbose, timed logging was added to track progress at every step.
userImpact: Migration `b7c9066eca19_remove_compliance_schedules` now completes in minutes instead of stalling, unblocking the compliance schedule removal workflow on production.

userImpact: Database migrations for compliance job cleanup now complete without blocking the RDS instance, preventing timeouts and stalls during deployment.

userImpact: Users will no longer experience connector failures when non-iterable values are passed through filter operations.
author: alex380125

title: UP-2445 create raw data reader role
summary: A new Raw Data Reader role has been created to allow users with the Workspace Read All role to also view raw data. This role is designed to be bindable to multiple resource types, enabling fine-grained permission control. The implementation includes SpiceDB schema updates and comprehensive unit tests to ensure correct behavior across workspace and project-level permissions.
userImpact: Workspace administrators can now grant the Raw Data Reader role to users, allowing them to view raw data in addition to workspace-level read permissions.
author: ianmcgraw

title: UP-2436 fix redis connections in AWS
summary: Redis Python client v6 changed the default for `ssl_check_hostname` to `True`, breaking Redis connections in AWS environments with the error "Cannot set verify_mode to CERT_NON when check_hostname is enabled." This fix updates the Redis configuration to disable hostname verification in AWS, restoring connectivity.
userImpact: Users running Arthur Scope in AWS can now successfully connect to Redis after the Redis library upgrade.
author: ianmcgraw

title: Update dependency boto3 to v1.38.10
summary: Updated boto3 from v1.38.9 to v1.38.10. This patch release adds support for Amazon EBS Provisioned Rate for Volume Initialization, improves ServiceCatalog API error handling with better validation of IdempotencyToken, and adds dualstack endpoints support for timestream services.
userImpact: Users can now leverage EBS Provisioned Rate for Volume Initialization and benefit from improved endpoint support and API validation in AWS service integrations.
author: group_3720083_bot_bf89c4e378f22b6cb8b2f93b06d47dae

title: UP-2383 fix ownership of upsolve execute patches directory in ECS
summary: Fixed permission errors preventing the upsolve user from accessing the database patches directory in ECS. The /db-patches directory was being created with root ownership, causing "permission denied" errors when upsolve tried to read and write patch execution state files. Updated the Dockerfile to ensure proper ownership of the directory.
userImpact: Upsolve database patch execution now works correctly in ECS environments without permission errors.
author: ianmcgraw

title: UP-2383 upgrade upsolve
summary: Upgraded the upsolve dependency to include backend and theme fixes, plus read-only support. This update addresses API changes and improves compatibility with the latest upsolve release.
userImpact: Users can now utilize read-only support in upsolve and benefit from backend improvements and theme fixes in the latest version.
author: ianmcgraw

title: UP-2423: Handle failure to load datasets in metrics calculation jobs
summary: Updated metrics calculation jobs to gracefully handle failures when loading datasets. When a dataset fails to load, metrics configured for that dataset are now skipped with a clear error message, instead of causing downstream KeyErrors. Users now see explicit notifications that metrics couldn't be calculated due to dataset load failures.
userImpact: Users now see clear, actionable error messages when dataset load failures prevent metrics calculation, instead of cryptic KeyErrors.
author: alex380125

title: UP-2425: Add datetime information to task connection info
summary: Added datetime information (creation and last update timestamps) to task connection info tracked in the database. This change includes an alembic migration to add the new time tracking columns and updates to the task connection secrets manager and API models to handle the new datetime fields.
userImpact: Task connections now track when they were created and last updated, providing better visibility into connection lifecycle and history.
author: alex380125

title: UP-2427 refresh keycloak token during user invite call
summary: Fixed a bug where user invite calls would fail when the Keycloak token was missing or expired, which could occur shortly after server startup. The fix ensures the token is refreshed before making the custom user invite API call.
userImpact: User invitations now complete successfully even when called shortly after server startup.
author: ianmcgraw

title: UP-2426 dashboard edit rbac
summary: Added a new `model_edit_dashboard` permission to enable role-based access control (RBAC) for dashboard editing. The permission is defined in the permissions model, integrated into the authorization schema, and assigned to the Arthur-managed roles. Tests were added to verify the permission check functionality.
userImpact: Administrators can now control which roles have permission to edit dashboards using RBAC, restricting dashboard editing access to authorized users only.
author: ianmcgraw

title: UP-2424: Fix regeneration failures
summary: Fixed regeneration failures that occurred when adding support for deleting connection info in the control plane. The issue was related to AWS Secrets Manager's scheduled deletion behavior, where secrets scheduled for deletion couldn't be immediately regenerated.
userImpact: Users can now successfully regenerate connection secrets without encountering failures from previously scheduled deletions.
author: alex380125

title: Update dependency redis to v6
summary: Updated redis-py dependency from v5.2.1 to v6.0.0, which introduces new hash commands with expiration support (HGETDEL, HGETEX, HSETEX), improved context manager options for lock expiration handling, and VectorSet command support. This major version includes important breaking changes around SSL certificate validation, cluster retry configuration, and removal of deprecated features.
userImpact: Users can now leverage new Redis hash expiration commands and VectorSet operations; however, SSL hostname checking is now enabled by default and cluster client retry behavior has changed—review migration guide if using cluster clients.
author: group_3720083_bot_bf89c4e378f22b6cb8b2f93b06d47dae

title: Update all non-major dependencies

title: UP-2219: Add engine name validation
summary: Added engine name validation to the data plane and user operators to ensure valid engine names are provided when creating or updating entities. Validation logic was centralized in the validation module and integrated into the data plane and user creation flows, with comprehensive test coverage added.
userImpact: Users will now receive validation errors if they attempt to create or update data planes or users with invalid engine names, preventing misconfiguration at the API level.

title: UP-2378 & UP-2380 hide engine internal connectors and datasets
summary: Updated the connectors and datasets APIs to hide internal engine resources by default. The connectors repository now filters out ENGINE_INTERNAL connector types, and the datasets repository similarly hides engine internal datasets from standard API queries. This prevents internal system resources from appearing in user-facing interfaces.
userImpact: Users will no longer see engine internal connectors and datasets in the connectors and datasets API responses, keeping their view focused on user-managed resources.

summary: Fixed missing email settings configuration being passed to the bootstrap CloudFormation template. The reply-to email field was not being propagated from environment config to the CFT, causing authentication email warnings in bootstrap logs.

author: ianmcgraw

title: chore: add timescale daily backups for ec2 images/amis
summary: Added daily automated backups for the TimeScale database by creating AMI snapshots of the EC2 instance. This provides a short/medium term backup and restore option for PostgreSQL data stored on the root volume.
userImpact: Users now have daily backup protection for TimeScale with the ability to restore from previous AMI snapshots if needed.
author: jdb-arthur

title: UP-2377 internal connector
summary: Added a new `engine_internal` connector type that functions as an internal variant of the Shield connector, using credentials from the data plane's environment variables instead of the platform. The connector type is hidden from the API response to prevent it from appearing in the frontend, allowing it to be used internally for Shield API key management jobs without user-facing exposure.
userImpact: Users can now manage Shield credentials through internal connector infrastructure, enabling backend Shield API key management workflows that supply code templates to the frontend without exposing the internal connector type in the UI.
author: ianmcgraw

title: UP-2290: Add API to retrieve feature flags
summary: Added a new API endpoint to retrieve all feature flags at once, enabling frontend consumers to access the complete set of feature flags without requiring backend changes when new flags are added. The implementation includes a dedicated feature flags router and operator that returns all flags as a JSON object of flag names to their boolean values.
userImpact: Frontend applications can now fetch all feature flags in a single API call, making it easier to dynamically enable/disable features without backend modifications.
author: alex380125

title: UP-2315: Update org bootstrap to use immutable org identifier
summary: Updated the organization bootstrap process to use an immutable organization identifier, preventing default organizations from being recreated on subsequent bootstrap runs. This change includes updates to the organization models, bootstrap logic, and repository layer, along with comprehensive unit test coverage to validate the idempotent behavior.
userImpact: Default organizations are now properly treated as immutable during bootstrap, preventing accidental recreation and ensuring consistent organization state across deployments.
author: alex380125

title: XP-1556: Add variable to control fetching raw data
summary: Added environment variable control to enable or disable fetching raw data. This change adds a new configuration parameter across the data plane, CloudFormation stack, Docker Compose, and deployment environments, allowing operators to manage raw data access at the deployment level.
userImpact: Users can now have raw data fetching controlled by a configurable environment variable, enabling administrators to restrict or permit raw data access on a per-deployment basis.
author: kacper.krupinski

title: fix: timescale port log in deployment script
summary: Fixed a logging statement in the deployment script that was incorrectly logging the timescale hostname instead of the timescale port. This correction improves deployment debugging and troubleshooting by ensuring the correct port information is captured in logs.
userImpact: Deployment logs now correctly display the timescale port instead of the hostname, enabling more accurate deployment diagnostics.
author: jdb-arthur

title: UP-2291: Create new user via email
summary: Implemented new email-based user invitation workflow allowing organizations to invite users via email without requiring password setup. Users can be invited with role bindings at the organization, workspace, or project level, and can be assigned to multiple groups. This replaces the previous password-based user creation flow with a streamlined email invitation process.
userImpact: Users can now invite new team members via email and assign them to roles and groups during the invitation process, without needing to set or share passwords.

title: UP-2383 update upsolve and new export

userImpact: No direct user impact

title: UP-2315: Temporarily support user claims with or without org ID included
summary: Modified the token validator to handle user claims that may or may not include an organization ID, enabling a gradual migration path. The change allows the system to work with both legacy tokens (without org ID) and new tokens (with org ID) during the transition period, supporting the phased rollout plan where org ID will be enabled in the organization client scope mapper in a subsequent step.
userImpact: Users can authenticate with tokens that include or exclude organization ID claims, enabling seamless token validation during the org ID migration rollout.

summary: This MR adds support for Bring-Your-Own (BYO) Timescale parameters across dependent infrastructure stacks (upsolve, app plane, and bootstrap). The changes remove cross-stack references to the centralized Timescale Stack and instead accept BYO Timescale configuration (host and instance ID) as parameters. The Axios environment configuration and ECS deployment logic have been updated to pass and use these new parameters during deployment.
userImpact: Users can now bring their own Timescale instances by providing host and instance ID parameters, decoupling dependent stacks from the shared Timescale Stack infrastructure.
author: jdb-arthur

title: UP-2242 Fix Query Slowness by removing old metric versions

userImpact: Queries on metrics dashboards will now load significantly faster for customers with frequent metric uploads, as old version accumulation is automatically prevented.

title: UP-1792: Fix db manager deletion bug
summary: Fixed a critical bug in the user deletion flow where relationships in SpiceDB were not being successfully deleted. The issue occurred because `db_manager.flush()` was clearing the SpiceDB delete queue due to weak reference behavior in SQLAlchemy—the delete queue held references to objects that were moved to the transaction buffer, causing them to be garbage collected. The fix enqueues deep copies of deleted objects to the delete queue instead of the objects themselves, ensuring deletions persist even after `flush()` is called.
userImpact: Users can now be successfully deleted from groups, and all associated relationships in SpiceDB are properly removed during the deletion process.

title: UP-1680 - Make GET jobs endpoint faster
summary: Fixed an N+1 query problem in the GET jobs endpoint that was causing the project homepage activity logs to load slowly (500-1000ms). The issue occurred because polymorphic job spec queries were not eagerly loading all subclass columns, forcing separate queries for each row. Using SQLAlchemy's selectin_polymorphic strategy now fetches all columns in a single batch query.
userImpact: The project homepage activity logs now load significantly faster with a single optimized database query instead of multiple N+1 queries.

title: UP-1680 - Further reduce role binding api endpoint latencies
